introduction_markdown: Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions. Section I is designed to be answered in 1 hour and Section II in 1 1/2 hours; you are advised to divide your time accordingly. In Section II answer EITHER the a, b and c OR the d, e and f of each question. For your guidance the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Where necessary, assume: the acceleration of free fall, $g = 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$; the speed of light in air, $c = 3\times10^{8}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$; the charge on an electron, $e = 1.6\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{C}$. Calculators are allowed.
incertitudes: Aucun corrigé officiel : toutes les réponses sont rédigées pour ce lot (modèle de réponse complet) ; les réponses qualitatives (définitions, listes, rédaction d'expériences) sont à relire par un enseignant de physique avant mise en avant.

Le sujet n'imprime pas de total par question : `points` de l'exercice = somme des points imprimés bloc par bloc ; pour la question 7, 8 et 9 de la Section II, c'est le total d'un seul jeu de sous-parties (a+b+c = d+e+f = 20), les deux jeux étant au choix.
Scan avec fantômes du verso (texte miroir qui transparaît) : relu en image sur la page nettoyée, aucun mot illisible dans les énoncés retenus.
6(b) : le diagramme des lignes de champ entre deux pôles opposés est à dessiner par l'élève ; il est décrit dans le corrigé, aucune figure de corrigé produite.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) State the basic law of magnetism. *[2 marks]*

(ii) Name one material which may be attracted by a magnet and one other material which may not be attracted by a magnet. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i)** **Like poles repel and unlike poles attract** (a north pole repels another north pole and attracts a south pole).

**(ii)**

- Attracted by a magnet (magnetic material): **iron** (also steel, nickel or cobalt).
- Not attracted by a magnet (non-magnetic material): **copper** (also aluminium, wood, plastic, glass).

questions.enonce_markdown: Draw a diagram to show the magnetic flux pattern between two unlike poles of magnets placed near each other. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Diagram to draw:** a bar magnet with its N pole on the left, facing the S pole of a second bar magnet on the right, with a gap between them.

- Draw several smooth **field lines leaving the N pole and entering the S pole**, each with an arrow pointing from N to S.
- Between the two poles the lines are almost **straight and parallel** in the gap, close together (strong field); they **bulge outwards** at the sides of the gap.
- The lines **never cross**, and they are **closest together near the poles**, where the field is strongest.

The pattern can be shown with iron filings sprinkled on a card above the magnets: the filings join the two poles along these lines.
